title: Working with people.
experience: At Charged Particles, I moved from development into project coordination, helping developers, designers, and leadership communicate about the work. At The Boston Globe, I built and maintained publishing sites and helped with a CMS migration.
people: I’m also a working bicycle mechanic, a former swimming instructor, and a former pedicab driver. I’m comfortable starting conversations, teaching, and helping when someone is frustrated. Understanding the person and explaining the next step are part of the work.
story: An adult swimmer I met was working hard but afraid of the deep end. I noticed how much tension he carried and helped him practice moving with less effort. We worked together in short sessions alongside his own practice. About six months later, he was swimming with the masters program and covering at least a kilometer a day.
